newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Accumulate Siam Cement - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Accumulate Siam Cement - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch on Thursday retained its accumulate recommendation on Siam Cement Plc despite the company's poor earnings in the first quarter this year.
"We retain our accumulate rating. Earnings are close (if not already at) cyclical low, as growth in sales and operating profit have shown improvement," Merrill Lynch said in a new report.

Siam Cement, Thailand's largest industrial group and cement producer, on Wednesday reported a 29 percent drop in its first quarter profit of 1.91 billion baht ($73.5 million) from 2.71 billion baht in the same quarter last year.
Siam Cement's business interests range from cement-making, paper and steel to petrochemicals.
"We estimate Siam Cement to have a long-run average earnings growth of about 14 percent," it said.
Merrill Lynch said Siam Cement's poor earnings in the first quarter were mainly due to weaker contributions from ceramic tiles and auto accessories.

The slump in the domestic property market has significantly weakened demand for ceramic tiles, while a slowdown in the auto market has adversely affected the firm's auto accessories business, it said.

But the group's steel division had shown a strong recovery in the first quarter following the government's implementation of anti-dumping and surcharges on steel imports from some countries, Merrill Lynch said.
